result.message: Search results do not match notion.so. The website notion.so belongs to Notion, and the results show Linear only as an integration partner on Notion’s site, not the owner of the website.

facts.claim: Linear is positioned as a tool for software teams to build products, focusing on issue tracking, project planning, and product roadmaps.
facts.excerpt: Linear empowers software teams to build better products. It streamlines issue tracking, project planning, and product roadmaps.
facts.source_title: Linear Integrations | Connect Your Apps with Notion

facts.claim: Notion offers a Linear link preview integration that shows Linear issues, views, and projects directly in Notion.
facts.excerpt: With this link preview integration, you can bring the magic of Linear to Notion. When you paste links from Linear, you’ll be able to see real-time previews of your issues, views, and projects directly in Notion.
facts.source_title: Linear Integrations | Connect Your Apps with Notion

facts.claim: Notion’s AI Connector for Linear lets users search Linear projects, issues, and comments from inside Notion.
facts.excerpt: Search Linear projects, issues, and comments from Notion.

facts.claim: The Linear AI Connector is available for all Linear organizations.
Linear’s Notion integration shows richer preview data, including issue title, description, status, issue ID, team, assignee, and last update date.
facts.excerpt: For issues, the preview shows issue title, description, status, issue ID, team, assignee, and the date of the last update.

facts.claim: Linear provides live previews in Notion that update when properties change in Linear.
facts.excerpt: Once any of these properties change in Linear, the preview in Notion changes accordingly (on page reload or manual preview refresh).

research.website_note: The website notion.so belongs to Notion, and the results show Linear only as an integration partner on Notion’s site, not the owner of the website.
research.gaps: No recent funding, hiring, pricing, customer logos, or partnership news about Linear was shown in these results.
